subject: Voting status: tables reproduced, memory scaling is the watch item
body:
Hi Zofia, Ivo,

Status. Reproduction closed Apr 22: tables 2 and 3 regenerate from the released scripts and match the paper, and the 2D line-fitting example (the paper's Figure 2 setup) is our smoke test in CI. Farah's bazel pinning means builds are hermetic now — c++17 flag and all.

Our-data results are promising: on the mid-density map region, the 6DoF voter matches the RANSAC stack's pose accuracy (median error 3.1cm vs 3.3cm) and is 2.7x faster at the 80% outlier ratio. At 90%+ outliers RANSAC's accuracy collapses while the voter degrades gracefully — that's the headline.

The watch item Ivo predicted: memory. The voting structure on our largest map tile peaks at 41GB, versus ~6GB for the paper-scale problems. Ondrej has a tile-partitioning scheme that trades ~4% recall on tile-boundary anchors for a 4x memory cut. We need a call on whether that trade is acceptable before the sweep configs freeze May 27.

Umar
